rows.source: 02:Services object ALL_RESPONSIVE, read live on vm-cerebrum-stg-01 (10.6.250.5:40009) 2026-09-25: available=1, type=ENUM enum=Error|OK, value OK. The device declares both states and names the good one.

00:System Redundancy_Status.Overall, read live 2026-09-25: available=1, type=ENUM enum=Error|OK, value OK. Served on this standalone server despite the folder name — the siblings that need a partner are not (see the note at the end of this file).

00:System Redundancy_Status.SQL_Log_Maintenance, read live 2026-09-25: available=1, type=ENUM enum=Error|OK, value OK. Minor rather than major: log maintenance failing degrades housekeeping, it does not stop routing.

00:System Redundancy_Status.Watchdog_Health, read live 2026-09-25: available=1, type=INTEGER range=0.000000..100.000000, value 100. The device publishes the scale and 100 is full health; the two steps within it are the only numbers in this file not taken from the device.

00:System License.Supported_Options, read live 2026-09-25: Northbound_API_Licenses=10, In_Use=0. The limit is the device's own number; major fires at it because one NB licence per session means the next connector is refused.
00:System License.Supported_Options, read live 2026-09-25: Resource_Manager_Licenses=500, In_Use=0. Minor at 90 % of the device's own limit.
00:System License.Supported_Options, read live 2026-09-25: IP_Destination_Limit=4096, In_Use=0. Minor at 90 % of the device's own limit.

00:System License, read live 2026-09-25: Demo_License_Enabled=Enabled, License_Type=Demo, Demo_License_Remaining=10000, Sentinel_Key_Serial_Number=Missing. A demo licence expires; on a licensed server the normal state is Disabled. This staging server raises this row today, which is correct — it is on a demo licence.
